_note: Belgard the Belfry Guardian with his greatsword (concept B, art/chapters/3-clock-tower/bosses/belgard/front/b-shoulder-sword-v1.png; concept A's planted-sword pose became the 'plant' clip). PixelLab 2026-11-16: 8 rotations from the concept, 7 clips x 8 directions in pixminimax (180px canvas, 9 frames each incl. the reference). Side views were asked for in profile and the north views 'viewed from behind' where the first take turned the body to the viewer (slam north; swing east, north-east, north, north-west). Attack frames carry slash arcs and impact bursts: drop or strip them when importing. Review sheets in review/.

barehanded._note: State 'Barehanded' of the same character (2026-11-17, user request: barehanded art for the flying sword).
